summary: National Grid plc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $750 million offering of 5.405% senior unsecured notes due 2036. The notes are priced at par, with an underwriting discount of 0.40% and net proceeds of $747 million. They rank pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt and are redeemable at option or upon certain tax events. Application will be made to list on the NYSE. Settlement is expected on June 9, 2026 via DTC. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
